headline: DeepSeek climbs to 29.7% of tokens while Claude Sonnet 5.5 sets an all-time share record
summary: DeepSeek's provider share reached 29.7% today, up 8.8 points over seven days, and the top three providers now hold 51.2% between them. Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 hit a fresh all-time high at 2.2% of tokens, a record that is only one day old.
highlights: DeepSeek's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash holds the top spot at 24.0% of model token share.
Together, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI hold 40.7%, and adding StepFun takes the top three to 51.2%.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 jumped 15 places in a week, from 27th-ish territory to 12th today.
Three new entrants arrived: Claude Fable 5.1 at 38th, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at 46th, and DeepSeek-V3.2 at 47th.
Grok 4.7, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and GPT-OSS-120B dropped out of the top 50 after ranking 45th, 47th, and 48th.
StepFun's Step-5-Preview sits second at 10.4%, though it lost 2.7 points in the last day.
